## Spokes: Reproducible Board Reporting for The Northwest Hub

Team: Sarah Alhusaynat (data pipeline, warehouse modeling, dashboard QA, documentation).

Spokes is an end-to-end analytics workflow that combines QuickBooks Online,
Lightspeed R-Series POS, and Neon Postgres into a board-ready Grafana dashboard.
The goal is simple: decision-ready reporting with reproducible pipeline steps and
clear operational runbooks.
